name: Market Microstructure Intelligence Engine — USD-M Perpetuals
scientificQuestion: Can causal derivatives microstructure information (taker flow, trade intensity, premium index and realized funding) rank long/short opportunities with positive net expectancy after fees, slippage and funding, while preserving materially better opportunity recall than the prior zero-selection engines?
priorContaminationDisclosure: Price outcomes through 2026-05-01 were inspected in earlier OHLC/context programs and are development-only here. The microstructure/funding features themselves were not previously used. 2026-05-01 onward remains unopened in this program.

sourceAuthority.provider: Binance official public data archive (data.binance.vision), USD-M futures
sourceAuthority.transport: Monthly ZIP archives with sibling .CHECKSUM files
sourceAuthority.note: The ordinary USD-M kline archive includes quote volume, trade count, taker-buy base volume and taker-buy quote volume; these are new order-flow/intensity features versus prior Yahoo OHLC research.

universeSelectionRule: Fixed pre-outcome set of 12 established USD-M perpetual majors; no symbol may be dropped or replaced after MIE1 outcomes except a fail-closed data-availability block before any performance computation.

candidateEngine.opportunityClock: Every completed 1h contract bar in fit/development creates exactly two directional research candidates: LONG and SHORT.
candidateEngine.atr: Wilder ATR14 from completed contract bars.
candidateEngine.evaluationExit: Full exit at TP2; otherwise stop; otherwise close at 24h time stop. TP1/TP3 are recorded for future construction diagnostics but do not alter MIE1 development PnL.
candidateEngine.opportunityLabel: TP2 barrier before stop barrier within 24h; adverse/stop wins same-bar ambiguity.

costAndFunding.includes: Taker-fee/slippage proxy on entry and exit plus realized funding events while position is open.
costAndFunding.fundingCashflow: For direction sign +1 LONG / -1 SHORT, funding R impact at each funding event while open = -sign * fundingRate * referenceNotional / initialRisk. Positive funding therefore costs longs and benefits shorts.
costAndFunding.fundingEventTiming: Funding events at timestamps <= exit timestamp and > entry timestamp are applied before final netR reporting; no future funding rate is used as an input before its timestamp.

targets.goodOpportunity: 1 when TP2=+1.5R is reached before stop=-1R inside 24h, stop wins same-bar.

models.preprocessing: MedianImputer + StandardScaler for numeric; OneHotEncoder for direction and symbolGroup.

score.semantics: Relative ranking score only. Component outputs are classifier scores, not calibrated real-world probabilities.

selection.perTimestamp: At each entry timestamp, for each symbol keep only the higher-score direction if LONG-vs-SHORT score margin >= 0.03. Rank remaining symbol winners by score and select the top 3.
selection.rationale: This prevents the zero-selection failure mode while forcing cross-sectional competition and preserving a measurable opportunity-recall budget.

bootstrap.method: hierarchical symbol circular hourly blocks over the frozen selected decision ledger

antiOverfit: No feature search after MIE1 development outcomes.
No fresh-validation/holdout access unless every development gate passes.
No R15 mutation before independent replication, fresh validation and sealed holdout.
failureRule: If MIE1 fails development, do not rescue it on MIE1 outcomes. Any continuation must be a separately locked program adding another genuinely new information source (e.g. historical open interest/liquidations/order-book depth/event data) rather than tuning these same microstructure features.
nextAuthorizedAction: Freeze and checksum only May-2025 through Apr-2026 contract 1h klines, premium-index 1h klines and funding history. Do not download May-2026 onward until the development gate passes.
